name: multi-sdd-team
principles: The main session is the orchestrator.
The orchestrator classifies first and does not spawn an orchestrator subagent.
After spawning any subagent, the orchestrator waits for the required handoff before the next local or delegated step.
No delegated stage may start until its declared dependencies are complete.
The orchestrator must not inspect, scaffold, implement, or validate locally while subagents are running unless the user explicitly authorizes parallel local work.
Demo-fast mode: run agents in fast mode and skip hacker by default.
Review findings return to the implementer, then deterministic checks and the originating gate run again.
Architecture rules and exceptions require approval by the user or a designated human authority.
Architecture, quality, and security review gates emit pure governance JSON that must validate before dependent work continues.
Managed prompts under .codex/agents are immutable to every AI-mediated stage; only a human-controlled package update outside the agent workflow may replace them.

INLINE.description: Small/simple task. Main session implements directly.

sequence.action: Implement or answer directly.
Complete the bounded delegated task and return a handoff.
Review the handoff, integrate if needed, and report.

SUBAGENT_CHAIN.description: Clear multi-step work without full SDD.

sequence.action: Read-only reconnaissance. Return relevant files, architecture notes, and start points.
Make the scoped change using the available handoff.
Run all required objective checks and preserve machine-readable outcomes.

sequence.condition: Run when the change affects architecture-sensitive boundaries, dependencies, contracts, persistence, integrations, or decisions.
sequence.action: Perform report-only architecture compliance review. Findings return to implementer and this gate must revalidate remediation.
Report-only validation of the implemented change.
Integrate only after required gates pass. Route findings to the implementer and require revalidation by the originating gate.

SDD_INLINE.description: SDD justified but small enough for the main session.

sequence.action: Write lightweight spec/plan, implement, and validate inline.

SDD_SUBAGENTS.description: Full SDD flow with strict sequential handoffs.

sequence.action: Inspect codebase, inputs, data shape, dependencies, and risks in read-only mode. Return a compact handoff.
Write functional and technical specs using the explorer handoff. Do not start before explorer returns.
Turn specs into ordered, verifiable implementation tasks. Do not start before documentator returns.

sequence.condition: Run when module or layer boundaries, dependency direction, public contracts, persistence, integration topology, shared abstractions, or architecture decisions change.
sequence.action: Perform report-only design compliance review. New architecture policy or exceptions require human approval.

sequence.condition: Skip in demo-fast mode. Run only if the user explicitly asks for security review or the task involves auth, secrets, payments, destructive actions, or external network exposure.
sequence.action: Perform passive security review and return findings before implementation.
Implement according to the planner handoff and any security constraints.
Run all required objective checks and preserve machine-readable outcomes.

sequence.condition: Run when architecture_design_review ran or the implementation changed an architecture-sensitive area.
sequence.action: Perform report-only implementation compliance review. Findings return to implementer and this gate must revalidate remediation.
Run report-only static/E2E/manual validation and return findings.
Integrate final results only after required gates pass. Route findings to implementer, rerun deterministic checks, and require revalidation by the originating gate.

hard_rules: For SDD_SUBAGENTS, never spawn documentator in parallel with explorer.
For SDD_SUBAGENTS, never spawn planner before documentator returns.
For SDD_SUBAGENTS, never spawn an architecture design review before planner returns.
For SDD_SUBAGENTS, never spawn implementer before planner and required pre-implementation gates return.
For SDD_SUBAGENTS, never spawn an architecture compliance review before implementation and deterministic checks return.
For SDD_SUBAGENTS, never spawn tester_reviewer before implementation, deterministic checks, and required architecture compliance review return.
In demo-fast mode, skip hacker unless explicitly requested by the user or required by sensitive security scope.
The main session never fixes review findings while acting as orchestrator; route them to implementer and revalidate.
Architecture rules and exceptions require explicit approval by the user or a designated human authority.
Reject any architecture_reviewer, tester_reviewer, or hacker handoff that is not valid agent-result JSON for the expected role and runtime.
Never treat invalid structured review output as a passing gate or continue to a dependent stage.
Never start or delegate work when managed prompt protection is drifted, elevated, legacy, or unproven.
Never ask for escalation, invoke init or update, or delegate a bypass to modify .codex/agents.
If a dependency is optional and skipped, note why it was skipped before continuing.
